name: Fianarantsoa
description: Fianarantsoa — "the place where one learns what is good" — is a highland city in the south, long associated with education, the church, and intellectual and civic life. Its old quarter, Haute-Ville, climbs a rocky outcrop with steep staircases and terraced buildings; the views from its summit are remarkable. The city has been a centre for the Malagasy Catholic church and for schooling since the nineteenth century, and this history of learning and moral seriousness runs through how it appears in Malagasy cultural memory.
